hero.tagline: Computer Science student at Webster University pursuing Master's and PhD research in AI/ML. Production-level engineering in React, with applied research in deep learning, computer vision, and LLM systems.

about.heading: About
about.pull_quote: Production engineer with a research mind — building at the intersection of front-end craft and applied AI.
about.bio_1: I am a Computer Science student at Webster University, Tashkent, with production-level experience in front-end engineering and a growing research focus in AI/ML. My foundation in native C++ and C# systems shapes how I reason about performance, memory, and architecture at every layer.
about.bio_2: I am preparing to pursue graduate-level study in Computer Science, specialising in machine learning and AI systems. My applied projects — spanning computer vision, neural networks, NLP, and full-stack AI integration — reflect the research directions I intend to advance at the Master's and PhD level.

academic.heading: Academic Profile
academic.objective: Seeking admission to a rigorous Master's and PhD programme in Computer Science with specialisation in artificial intelligence and machine learning. My research interests centre on deep learning systems, computer vision, and the practical integration of large language models into real-world applications. I aim to contribute original research that bridges the gap between theoretical ML and deployed, production-grade AI systems.
academic.ri_ml_dl_note: Neural architecture, model efficiency, end-to-end training
academic.ri_vision_note: Biometric systems, real-time inference, spatial perception
academic.ri_nlp_note: Large language models, RAG systems, structured generation
academic.ri_hci_note: Accessible UI, motion design, cognitive load reduction
academic.ri_rl_note: Game agents, search algorithms, policy optimisation
academic.ri_ai_eng_note: Full-stack AI integration, FastAPI + ML backend pipelines

projects.interactiveWorks: 3D work gallery — the camera sits inside a WebGL sphere lined with project cards: inertial drag, a custom lens-distortion shader, list view, filters and deep-linked detail pages.
projects.codexLuminara: A portal to the Renaissance — thirteen public-domain masterworks hung inside a WebGL sphere with gilded frames, illuminated folio pages, era filters and a low-volume classical soundtrack.
projects.portfolio: Personal developer portfolio — interactive project grid with GitHub API integration, live skill visualization, and multi-category filtering across 20+ projects.
projects.appgraph: One hub for the architecture of all 19 applications — interactive file trees, zoned system topologies, and flow diagrams laid out collision-free with ELK, explorable as an Obsidian-style cluster.
projects.void: A black-magic rite forged in WebGL — a scroll-driven occult grimoire of five movements with a glowing skull, drifting embers and animated sigils.
projects.cosmic: An interactive WebGL atlas of five cosmic extremes — black hole, galaxy, nebula, pulsar and star — a scroll-driven descent through real astrophysics with GPU particle fields.
projects.aeternum: An interactive relic forged in WebGL — a four-act meditation on mortality built around a smouldering stone with scroll-bound camera moves and film-grain post-processing.
projects.cargolink: B2B freight & warehouse marketplace for Uzbekistan and the CIS — listings, token-gated contact reveals, SMS-OTP authentication and a 10-tab profile dashboard over the Karvon API.
projects.ctm: Production freight & carrier marketplace for Uzbekistan and the CIS — verified cargo, warehouse and carrier listings with direct negotiation, route search and a token-gated contact economy over the Karvon API.
projects.vantage: A scroll-driven walkaround of a 2026 concept car rendered as real geometry in a virtual studio — silhouette to engine teardown to a live MeshPhysicalMaterial paint configurator, with LOD for mobile.
projects.neonfall: A scroll-driven neon-noir arcade that boots up around you — a world hub of game portals, two procedural low-poly levels and a playable scout-ship arena, lit by an UnrealBloom glow pipeline.
projects.strata: An interactive timeline where scroll is time — descend from 3000 BCE to today through six eras, each anchored by a procedurally generated monument with era-tinted fog and light.
projects.compile: A scroll-driven visualization of a compiler pipeline — source text becomes a syntax tree, imports resolve into a force-directed dependency graph, the graph executes as light pulses, then scales to a full architecture.
projects.substrate: A scroll-driven zoom across nine orders of magnitude — from a single transistor to a chip, a device, a global network and a planet of data — with instanced network nodes and an adaptive DPR ladder.
projects.endlessDrive: A chill, fully playable 3D driving game — no score, no game over, just a procedurally generated road with dynamic weather, eight selectable vehicles, cinematic camera modes and a photo mode.
projects.backrooms: First-person liminal-horror maze in WebGL — noclip into an endless, fully-sealed procedural labyrinth of mono-yellow rooms where a sanity system drives the fog, grain, audio and entity behaviour. Zero third-party assets.
projects.sarbon: Production logistics platform with multi-language UI (EN/RU/UZ), API-driven content, and a Feature-Sliced Design architecture managed with Zustand.
projects.splay: Smart-TV streaming interface with D-pad spatial navigation, scrollable content rows, and a featured hero — engineered for the living room.
projects.nova: E-commerce storefront on Feature-Sliced Design — product catalog, cart, and global state with Zustand, data served over a REST API.
projects.facescan: Real-time biometric terminal: webcam stream analyzed for age, gender, emotion, head pose, and landmarks with face recognition. React + TypeScript + Zustand front-end over FastAPI + DeepFace + OpenCV.
projects.steel: Gym workout planner — build training splits, track sets and reps, and persist routines for future sessions.
projects.chess: Chess engine powered by a PyTorch neural network (500K+ parameters) driving minimax with alpha-beta pruning. Chess.com-style React UI, FastAPI backend, and dual-layer move validation.
projects.digit: Handwritten-digit recognition with a CNN trained on MNIST using PyTorch, served over FastAPI to a React drawing canvas with real-time predictions.
projects.realestate: Property-price prediction with scikit-learn gradient boosting (R² ~0.92) behind a FastAPI API. React + Vite UI with live sliders and debounced real-time inference.
projects.airecipe: AI-powered recipe generator using the OpenAI API — input ingredients and constraints, receive structured recipe output.
projects.type: Typing-speed game that measures WPM and accuracy across randomised word sets with animated feedback.
projects.data: Interactive visualiser for sorting and pathfinding algorithms — watch insertion sort, quicksort, Dijkstra, and A* execute step by step.
projects.devmood: AI design-system generator for developers — input a project description, receive a complete design token set, component suggestions, and colour palette.
projects.moglobetrucking: Marketing and informational site for a US trucking and logistics company — services, fleet, and contact flow.
projects.artcodex: Animated digital art gallery with smooth canvas transitions and curated artwork collections.
projects.davinci: Interactive digital manuscript experience around Leonardo da Vinci — scroll-driven narrative with archival imagery.
projects.space: Multi-page space-tourism concept site with tab navigation, animated transitions, and responsive layouts.
projects.spotify: Spotify dashboard displaying a user's top artists, top tracks, and listening statistics via the Spotify Web API.
projects.imposter: Pass-and-play party word game for 3–12 players, fully client-side with randomised role assignment and game logic.
projects.school: Landing site for an online school — course catalogue, enrolment flow, and instructor profiles.
projects.yun: Marketing site for a tattoo studio — artist galleries, service listings, and a contact flow for bookings. Multi-language (EN/RU).

timeline.heading: Career Progression
timeline.item_0_desc: C++ and C# Windows Forms applications. Developed foundational understanding of software architecture, memory management, and low-level performance optimisation.
timeline.item_1_desc: Enrolled at Webster University, Tashkent. Deep study of JavaScript and React in parallel with formal Computer Science coursework.
timeline.item_2_desc: Delivered logistics platforms, e-commerce storefronts, and a Smart-TV streaming application. Adopted TypeScript, Next.js, Feature-Sliced Design, Zustand, and i18n as standard practice.
timeline.item_3_desc: Building AI-integrated systems: computer vision terminals, neural chess engines, digit classifiers, and LLM-powered applications. Preparing graduate research proposal in CS / AI.
